# 4 Ezra Chapter 10 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin Vulgate (Codex Sangermanensis) | **Section:** Core apocalypse — Vision of the woman/Zion

---

**1** And it came to pass, after my son entered his wedding chamber and died, I overturned all my lamps, and all my neighbors rose to comfort me; and I rested quietly until the evening of the second day.

**2** And it came to pass when they all ceased to comfort me that I rose up by night and fled, and came here to this field, as you see.

**3** And I purpose not to return to the city, but to stay here; and I will neither eat nor drink, but will continually mourn and fast until I die.

**4** Then I left the meditations in which I had been, and I answered her in anger and said:

**5** You most foolish of all women! Do you not see our mourning, and what has befallen us?

**6** How Zion, the mother of us all, is full of sorrow and much humbled!

**7** Mourn now especially because of her mourning; be sorry for her sorrow; for she mourns most of all, she for whom you all mourn so greatly.

**8** For as the field is given to the forest, so Zion's husbandman has changed; and as a fire, so the blaze of her enemies' glory has consumed her.

**9** As for her ornaments, her inhabitants have been taken away; as for her jewels, her children are scattered abroad.

**10** Her daughters are enslaved and her virgins led captive; her chosen ones are laid low and her young men have fallen by the sword.

**11** What more can the bridegroom offer you than what I have offered? Or what more can you lose in the wedding than what I have lost?

**12** For behold, my bridegroom is the Most High: Zion is Jerusalem; for she was espoused to the Most High before all others that were ordained to dwell in her.

**13** And he prepared habitations for her, and from the beginning he sanctified her with glory as the place of his own dwelling.

**14** And when she was forsaken because of sin and abandoned, she grieved greatly.

**15** Therefore put away your great sorrow and lay aside the multitude of your griefs, that the Mighty One may be gracious to you again, and the Most High may give you rest — a respite from your travail.

**16** Now while I was speaking to her — lo! her face suddenly shone exceedingly, and her countenance glistened, so that I was afraid of her; and I wondered what had happened to her.

**17** And behold! she suddenly uttered a great and fearful cry, so that the earth shook at the noise of the woman.

**18** And I looked, and behold: the woman was no more visible to me, but there was a city built, and a place of large foundations showed itself; then I was afraid and cried out with a loud voice and said:

**19** Where is the angel Uriel, who came to me at first? For it is he who brought me into this amazement; and my end has become corruption, and my prayer has become a reproach.

**20** And while I was speaking these words, behold, he came to me, and looked upon me,

**21** and lo! I lay as one dead, and my understanding was taken from me; and he took me by the right hand and strengthened me and set me on my feet and said to me:

**22** What ails you? Why are you troubled? And why is your mind and the understanding of your heart disturbed?

**23** And I said: Because you have forsaken me! I did as you commanded, and went out into the field, and lo! what I have seen and still see, I am not able to tell you.

**24** And he said to me: Rise up as a man, and I will instruct you.

**25** And I said: Speak, my lord; only do not forsake me, lest I die before my time.

**26** For I have seen what I did not know, and I hear what I do not understand.

**27** Or is my mind deceived, and my soul dreaming?

**28** Now therefore I beseech you to show your servant the meaning of this bewilderment.

**29** And he answered me and said: Hear me, and I will inform you, and tell you of the things which you fear; for the Most High has revealed many hidden things to you.

**30** He has seen that your way is right: that you grieve continually for your people, and mourn greatly for Zion.

**31** This therefore is the meaning of the vision:

**32** The woman who appeared to you just now — whom you saw mourning and began to comfort —

**33** but now you see her face no more, but there appeared to you a city in building:

**34** this is the meaning — the woman whom you saw is Zion, which you now behold as a city being built.

**35** And whereas she told you that she was barren thirty years, that means: because there were three thousand years in the world in which there was yet no offering made in her.

**36** And it came to pass after three thousand years that Solomon built the city and offered offerings; then it was that the barren one bore a son.

**37** And whereas she told you that she nurtured her son with travail: that was the dwelling in Jerusalem.

**38** And whereas she said to you: My son coming into his wedding chamber died, and disaster befell her — this means:

**39** this also is the fall of Jerusalem. And whereas you saw her mourning for her son, Zion is that which mourns for the multitude of her children.

**40** And the cause of her grief which you saw: this is what Zion has been enduring since the time of her mourning.

**41** And now since you saw the likeness of her being built — this is because the Most High wills to show you his city.

**42** And the reason why she had no eyes: because she was not able to see the building of the city.

**43** And the vision of her standing exalted and firm on a great and broad foundation was told you as follows:

**44** She appeared exalted and standing firm on a great foundation because the Most High has laid a strong foundation for her glory.

**45** And whereas you saw a city and not a fixed place: that means that Zion has now appeared without a foundation stone, not yet as a complete city, but as a city in the building.

**46** And whereas you were afraid when you saw her face suddenly shine exceedingly: that is because the Most High has revealed his city to you, and henceforth it is to be built.

**47** And whereas you saw that she suddenly cried with a loud voice — lo! she departed from you — that means: God speaks not now with those who dwell on earth; but these are the visions reserved for heaven.

**48** And whereas she showed you her form more gloriously, and appeared on a place of great foundations: this means what you see, and what I shall declare.

**49** Because of this the Most High showed you these things, and said that it should be so.

**50** Therefore I commanded you, when you were in the field, that when you had eaten the flowers of the field — in which no human building was — the Most High might begin to show you these visions.

**51** And again I said: Stand up and I will show you something.

**52** And I saw, and behold: the woman was seen no more, but there was a city built, and a place showed itself that was exceedingly large; and I said: What is this? And he said to me: This is the city that is the beginning of our kingdom.

**53** Now arise and go; for tomorrow at night you will see more; and the Most High will show you great things, and will strengthen you further.

**54** And I went and walked in the field as he commanded me, greatly glorifying and praising the Most High for his wonders which he did in due season, and because he directs the times and the things that pass in their seasons.

**55** And there I sat, and did not eat nor drink, for I was meditating upon him.

**56** And it came to pass that after seven days, sitting on the grass, my heart was troubled again as before,

**57** and my mouth was opened, and I began to speak before the Most High, and said:

**58** O LORD, you showed yourself to those who had believed you, and you gave them comfort and rest.

**59** Now show yourself also to us, and this land through which you established things: O LORD, how great are your works! How mighty are your wonders! How powerful are your words! And your thoughts are past finding out!
